stops.title: 3d series: Electronic configuration, oxidation states & magnetic moment
stops.inShort: General outer configuration of d-block: (n−1)d¹⁻¹⁰ ns¹⁻². Exceptions: Cr ([Ar]3d⁵4s¹), Cu ([Ar]3d¹⁰4s¹). Spin-only magnetic moment μ = √(n(n+2)) BM. Ti⁴⁺ (3d⁰) is colourless due to absence of unpaired d-electrons.

stops.title: K₂Cr₂O₇, KMnO₄ & Metallurgy of Iron (Blast furnace)
stops.inShort: K₂Cr₂O₇ is prepared from chromite ore (FeCr₂O₄) via Na₂CrO₄ → Na₂Cr₂O₇ → K₂Cr₂O₇. In blast furnace reduction zone (500–800 K), Fe₂O₃ is reduced to Fe by CO (and C at higher temp). Brass = Cu + Zn.

stops.title: Lanthanoids, Actinoids & Lanthanoid contraction
stops.inShort: Lanthanoid contraction: steady decrease in atomic/ionic radii from La to Lu due to poor shielding by 4f electrons. Gd (Z=64): [Xe] 4f⁷ 5d¹ 6s². Transuranium elements: Z > 92 (93 to 118).

items.s: n = number of unpaired electrons; BM = Bohr Magneton.

board.text: Write the names of the metal elements in brass alloy.
Write the differences between lanthanoids and actinoids.
board.answer:
1. Differentiating electron enters 4f-orbital in lanthanoids, and 5f-orbital in actinoids.
2. Lanthanoids show +3 (and +2, +4) oxidation states; actinoids show a wider range (+3 to +7).
3. Lanthanoids (except Pm) are non-radioactive; all actinoids are radioactive.
4. Lanthanoids have less tendency to form complexes than actinoids.

board.text: (a) Calculate spin only magnetic moment of M²⁺ ion [atomic number of M = 26]. (b) Write condensed electronic configuration of Gadolinium [Z = 64].
board.answer:
(a) M (Z=26, Fe): [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s² ⇒ M²⁺: [Ar] 3d⁶ (4 unpaired electrons, n = 4).
μ = √(4(4 + 2)) = √24 = 4.899 BM.
(b) Gadolinium (Z=64): [Xe] 4f⁷ 5d¹ 6s².

board.text: The spin only magnetic moment of Cr³⁺ cation is ____.
Define Lanthanide contraction. Write the balanced chemical equations when acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ reacts with H₂S.
board.answer:
Lanthanide contraction: The gradual decrease in atomic and ionic radii of lanthanoids with increasing atomic number from La (57) to Lu (71).
Reaction: K₂Cr₂O₇ + 4 H₂SO₄ + 3 H₂S → K₂SO₄ + Cr₂(SO₄)₃ + 7 H₂O + 3 S↓.
